verdict.rationale: The evidence shows bot-free recording from the Mac/Windows desktop app and transcription of uploaded audio/video files into searchable text. It also shows search across meetings and transcripts in a shared, organized workspace, so the 'lands in one searchable workspace' half is covered. Nothing documents a mobile app or in-person capture on a phone, so the founder would need a workaround such as recording elsewhere and uploading the file. Missing for 10: a documented mobile recording app, explicit in-person conversation capture, and hands-on corroboration that mobile recordings sync into the same workspace.
